round_history.retrieved_content:
[DAY2 21:42:30 - DAY2 21:42:59]
I walk into the kitchen and rub my hands. I pick up a grape and take a bite. Choiszt: Aren't you going to wash up? "It's not a big deal, not a big deal," I say, waving my right hand. I watch Choiszt, take grapes from his hand, and briefly adjust my glasses. "Oh, you want to give me one?" I ask. "Thanks," I say. "Hmm," I mutter, and "It's like this," I add. I hurry toward Alice's room, knock, open the door, and enter.

[DAY2 22:42:02 - DAY2 22:42:27]
Shure operates his phone and picks up grapes while Nicous grabs his phone. I quietly watch my colleagues, reach out, and grab a grape. "It has to charge up to around 5%, right?" I say. I bite the grape—"10%, hmm," I add—and keep eating while looking at them.

[DAY2 22:01:30 - DAY2 22:01:59]
I look toward the kitchen, then glance at a glass and see my reflection. I pick up a grape and eat it, take a few steps forward, and spot Choiszt. I lean against the doorframe, scanning the room's corners, then bend down to scan the bottom of the whiteboard.
